text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The D11 paragraph is the only load-bearing comment here and it is verified: metrics.py imports is_test_entity and builds a test-origin set from it, so fan-in still counts only edges originating in production code. The reasoning it records - a fixture called thousands of times by tests says nothing about production centrality, and coverage is a separate positive signal - still describes why. The compute/churn dividers still label their sections.
